title: IReNe: Instant Recoloring of Neural Radiance Fields

layout.note: Three zones split by dashed rules. The top zone runs left to right: two stacked inputs, a heavy-framed model box opened to show its networks, and the edited multi-view output, with a stopwatch line under the box. The lower-left zone holds four captioned before/after photo pairs in two columns of two, each with a magnified crop. A tall right zone stacks three red Lego renders with two black-framed crops each.

lesson: A teaser can combine a short input-to-output chain with real images, one opened box for the new mechanism and a stopwatch line for the cost headline, with result tiles below as before/after pairs whose framed regions are magnified by leader lines.
